_about: Pre-registered (Phase 2, before the first load) rules that map a manufacturer or recalling-firm name to a parent company. Step 1, clean: upper-case, '&' kept, other punctuation removed, trailing site numbers ('- 9616671') removed, trailing legal suffixes removed (list below), spaces collapsed. Step 2, parent: the first pattern found as a whole-word substring of the clean name decides; no match = the clean name itself. Only well-documented ownership is encoded; anything uncertain stays separate. Changes after the first load are labelled post hoc in docs/PIPELINE.md.

parents.source: DePuy is the orthopaedics company of Johnson & Johnson
Howmedica Osteonics is Stryker's orthopaedic subsidiary
Abbott acquired St. Jude Medical in 2017
